en.gameDesc: Build BFS and DFS spanning trees, perform preorder/postorder/inorder traversals, and answer questions about rooted trees, m-ary trees, and Cayley's theorem.

af.gameDesc: Bou BFS- en DFS-spanbome, voer pre-orde/post-orde/in-orde deurkruisings uit, en beantwoord vrae oor gewortelde bome, m-rige bome, en Cayley se stelling.

zu.gameDesc: Yakha izihlahla ezihlanganisayo ze-BFS ne-DFS, yenza ukudlula kwe-preorder/postorder/inorder, uphendule imibuzo ngezihlahla ezinempande, izihlahla ze-m-ary, nesithiyo sika-Cayley.
